g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'UK net borrowing against previous-year debt, by era, % of GDP (war years excluded). A downward slope means governments borrowed less as debt rose. The slope flattens in the recent era.'

text.tspan: UK net borrowing against previous-year debt, by era, % of GDP (war years excluded).
A downward slope means governments borrowed less as debt rose. The slope flattens in the recent era.
